result.instructions: Tools for DicksonOne, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which temperature alerts are still active, and which locations do they belong to?"; "Show me the excursion alerts from the last 24 hours for the walk-in fridges."; "Show the comments on alert 5, then acknowledge it if nobody has yet.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DicksonOne data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dicksonone_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dicksonone_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dicksonone_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. dicksonone_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dicksonone_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the DicksonOne user that the API token belongs to. Good first call to confirm the connection. REST API: GET /api/rest/whoami.

tools.name: dicksonone_list_alerts
tools.title: List alerts
tools.description: List historical alerts for the account: a logger tripped a warning or excursion condition. Each alert has severity, type, excursion_at, returned_to_normal_at, acknowledged_at and its location, device and channel. Filter by logger, location, severity, type, active state or time window. Paginated. REST API: GET /api/rest/alerts.

tokens.description: Restrict to data loggers by token (from dicksonone_list_devices).

location_ids.description: Restrict to locations by id (from dicksonone_list_locations).

active.description: true = only active alerts (not yet returned to normal).

ended_after.description: Only alerts resolved after this time.

ended_before.description: Only alerts resolved before this time.

tools.name: dicksonone_get_alert_summary
tools.title: Alert counts
tools.description: Count active and cleared alerts, and alerts by severity (excursion, warning), for the account or for a filtered set. REST API: GET /api/rest/alerts/summary.

tokens.description: Restrict to data loggers by token (from dicksonone_list_devices).

location_ids.description: Restrict to locations by id (from dicksonone_list_locations).

active.description: true = only active alerts (not yet returned to normal).

ended_after.description: Only alerts resolved after this time.

ended_before.description: Only alerts resolved before this time.

tools.name: dicksonone_list_alert_comments
tools.title: List alert comments
tools.description: List the comments that users added to one alert, with author and time. Paginated. REST API: GET /api/rest/alerts/{alert_id}/comments.

tools.name: dicksonone_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the locations (sites, rooms, fridges) on the account, with their sublocation ids. Use the ids to filter alerts. Filter by name or by a list of ids. Paginated. REST API: GET /api/rest/locations.

tools.name: dicksonone_list_devices
tools.title: List data loggers
tools.description: List the data loggers (devices) on the account. Each logger has a string token that stays the same across hardware replacements; use the token to filter alerts. Optionally filter by name and include archived or replaced loggers. Paginated. REST API: GET /api/rest/devices.

include_replacements.description: Include older serials of replaced loggers (default false).

tools.name: dicksonone_acknowledge_alert
tools.title: Acknowledge an alert
tools.description: Acknowledge one alert. The API sets the acknowledger to the user of the token and the time to the server time. An alert that is already acknowledged returns HTTP 409; the tool reports that as an error, and nothing changes. REST API: POST /api/rest/alerts/{alert_id}/acknowledgements.

alert_id.description: The alert id to acknowledge (from dicksonone_list_alerts).
